doc_title: APPLICATION TO REMOVE OR VARY A RESTRICTION
doc_title_official: APPLICATION TO REMOVE OR VARY A RESTRICTION
when_used: An applicant or person interested applies to the Land Registrar to vary or remove a registered restriction, setting out the grounds.

detail_rows.label: Date of Application to remove or vary a Restriction
Applicant/Person Interested: Give full name(s) and if corporate the registration number, if any
ID/Passport/Company Registration No. of Applicant/Person Interested(if any)

body_text.text: The Applicant/Person Interested HEREBY APPLIES to the Land Registrar to vary/remove* the Restriction registered in Entry Number(s) {{entry_numbers}} on the Encumbrances Section of the Register on the grounds that:
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this application for removal/variation of Restriction has been duly executed this ................. day of……………. 20….

custom_fields.name: restriction_date
custom_fields.label: Date of the Restriction
custom_fields.prompt: The date of the restriction to be removed or varied

custom_fields.name: entry_numbers
custom_fields.label: Entry number of the Restriction
custom_fields.prompt: The entry number or numbers of the restriction in the register

custom_fields.name: grounds
custom_fields.label: Grounds for the application
custom_fields.prompt: The grounds for removing or varying the restriction, one ground per line
